officialSources.claim: Opening representations require the uploader to be the sole depicted subject and control necessary input rights. Section2 reiterates that the uploader is the person depicted; another individual is not an eligible input. This is a provider rule, not a backend or account-use observation.

officialSources.claim: FAQ describes commercial use for Firefly outputs, with product-specific exceptions for beta features; it discusses Content Credentials as provenance. It does not establish that every partner model or input is suitable for every client use.

officialSources.claim: Current plans distinguish Adobe Firefly outputs from partner-model outputs. Suitability of partner-model content is the creator's responsibility; IP indemnification is limited to eligible enterprise customers and selected outputs. No price quotation is added to the candidate.

Official documentation provides the exact public car-sample URL and URL-based Inspect route used here. It describes viewing credentials and source history. This documentation reading is not counted as the hands-on observation.

observations.relevance: Directly checks the provenance handoff portion of the client-delivery article; not generation quality, export behavior or licensing permission.
observations.product: Adobe Content Authenticity Inspect Beta; public CAI example asset
observations.task: Inspect a supplied image's recorded creation history and warning before treating it as ready for a client handoff.

conditions.browser: Chrome extension-controlled browser, existing browser default viewport; no responsive-size override
conditions.account: Signed out: visible Sign in button; no account created or logged in
conditions.plan: Public Inspect Beta, no paid entitlement used
conditions.source: Official CAI public car JPEG; no user file or personal image

steps: Opened the exact public-sample Inspect URL linked by official CAI documentation.
Read the resulting Inspect view while it showed Sign in.
Activated Show sources (1), then read the source-history view and credential details.
Saved the resulting screenshot and DOM text.
observations.result: The viewer displayed the recorded name car-es-1sm.jpg, Created with Adobe Photoshop, and a warning that the file uses a legacy C2PA specification version. Expanding sources showed a single sample source node. The observed record is not a Firefly-generation test.
observations.readerImpact: A handoff check should record the displayed creation application and any credential warning instead of treating the existence of metadata as permission to use an asset. Follow with a separate check of actual model/account/input rights.
observations.limits: One public sample only. No SpicyBox or Firefly output was generated, uploaded, downloaded or exported; no commercial license or client permission was verified by the viewer. The sample result cannot establish either product's generation quality or export coverage.
